threads.body: [General] This shared Dockerfile now selects ZIP for every Linux WildFly target, including 13, 17, 21, and 28–30. That contradicts the PR’s stated requirement to preserve the existing tar.gz extraction path for older releases, and the claimed older-release tar validation can no longer exercise that path. Keep tar.gz as the default and pass a per-target archive format/extraction mode only for 41.0.1.Final.
threads.hunk:
@@ -17,24 +17,24 @@ WORKDIR /opt/jboss
 
 # latest eclipse-temurin docker images have removed curl in favor of wget (https://github.com/adoptium/containers/issues/630)
 # but ibm-semeru-runtimes docker images lack wget
-RUN apt-get update && apt-get -y install wget
+RUN apt-get update && apt-get -y install wget unzip
 
 # Specify the user which should be used to execute all commands below
 USER jboss
 
 # Set the WILDFLY_VERSION env variable
 ENV WILDFLY_VERSION=${version}
-ENV DOWNLOAD_URL=${baseDownloadUrl}.tar.gz
+ENV DOWNLOAD_URL=${baseDownloadUrl}.zip

replies.body:
Addressed in eaedc2fd071c280daa4feac386a9153874ba72ed.

The frozen Dockerfile forced .zip downloads and unzip for every Linux WildFly release. Added archiveFormat=tar.gz by default with explicit tar.gz/ZIP extraction and passed archiveFormat=zip only for 41.0.1.Final. Verified older HotSpot/OpenJ9 targets omit the override and Windows remains ZIP-based.
